# PDF Text Extractor API

> Fast PDF text extraction, layout analysis, and intelligent OCR primitive on Apify.
> Designed for programmatic pipelines, n8n workflows, and AI Agents.

## Capabilities

- Extracts digital text via PDFium (1-8 ms/page)
- Runs OCR via Tesseract 5 only on scanned pages without text
- Pay-per-event pricing: broken files, 404s, and empty PDFs are free ($0.002 per successful PDF)
- Built-in RAG chunking with precise pageStart and pageEnd citation metadata
- Accepts direct links, Google Drive share links, Dropbox, and arXiv abstract URLs

## Endpoints

- Synchronous Actor run: `POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/sumitr_mardy~pdf-text-extractor/run-sync-get-dataset-items`
- Actor Store: https://apify.com/sumitr_mardy/pdf-text-extractor
- Pricing: https://apify.com/sumitr_mardy/pdf-text-extractor/pricing
- Repository: https://github.com/sumitrmardy/pdf-text-extractor-api

## Output Schema Summary

- `url` (string): Input URL
- `status` (string): `ok` | `no_text` | `failed`
- `subStatus` (string): `text_layer` | `ocr_recovered` | `scanned_ocr_off` | `budget_incomplete` | `invalid_url` | `not_a_pdf`
- `pageCount` (integer): Total pages in document
- `pagesExtracted` (integer): Number of pages processed
- `ocrPages` (integer): Scanned pages recovered with OCR
- `charCount` (integer): Extracted characters
- `text` (string): Full document text
- `pages` (array): Array of page objects with `pageNumber` and `text`
- `chunks` (array): Pre-chunked text with `pageStart` and `pageEnd` metadata when `chunkSize` is requested
